verdict.rationale: ernd is a corporate card for AI vendor spend, so spend controls are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence covers only rewards, partner perks, signup and withdrawal. Nothing documents restricting cards by category, merchant or amount, or auto-declining out-of-policy spend at the point of sale. The suggestion to put only AI vendors on the card is a user-side arrangement, not a product control.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can restrict cards by category, merchant, and amount — and the platform auto-locks or declines out-of-policy spend at the point of sale
